description: Répartition des opérateurs de dépoliement chez l'habitant de la fibre optique (OI) par commune is a dataset listed in Opendata de Grand Paris Sud open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Numérique @ Grand Paris Sud. Cette carte présente les opérateurs de réseau pour la fibre optique par communes de Grand Paris Sud. L’opérateur déploie le câble de fibre optique. Le Fournisseur d’accès internet propose ses services via un abonnement et pour ce faire utilise la fibre. L’opérateur peut être le FAI, mais pas obligatoirement. Coverage: Grand Paris Sud (Essonne and Seine-et-Marne). The portal files it under Télecommunications. Its keywords are fibre, Fibre Optique, fibre-optique, fibre optique, Grand Paris Sud, opérateur immeuble. The portal shows 24 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-07-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-grandparissud-fr-portal.
